description:
FILED s480 (Fable, 2026-09-09) from docs/plan-publish-s480.md P7.  USER: "Percolisp will be an experiment, until we can run DBI etc." and, asked, "DBI was just an example of critical infrastructure."  So the milestone is a LIST, and this task PROPOSES it and SIZES it; the USER fixes the list.

PROPOSED LIST (prune/extend -- the modules a Perl deployment cannot do without), grouped by what they need:
  A. PURE PERL -- on the CPAN board today or one board round away (#1504): Getopt::Long, JSON::PP, Data::Dumper (its PP half), Path::Tiny, HTTP::Tiny, Try::Tiny, Moo, Test::More itself (subtest is #1576), File::Temp/File::Spec/Cwd (shipped), Text::CSV_PP, YAML::Tiny, Pod::Usage.
  B. XS THROUGH PCLXS: DBI + one DBD (DBD::SQLite bundles sqlite3.c; DBD::Pg/mysql need client libraries), Encode, Storable, Time::HiRes, List::Util/Scalar::Util XS (the shim covers most; #238/#1286/#1571), Digest::SHA (Digest::MD5 works: #115), Cpanel::JSON::XS or JSON::XS, POSIX (partly a shim), Socket/IO::Socket (#1574).
  C. FRAMEWORKS THAT STRESS EVERYTHING: Plack (+ HTTP::Server::PSGI), Mojolicious, DateTime, Template Toolkit, Log::Log4perl, Moose (Moo works; Moose is XS-optional + MOP).

PER MODULE, the deliverable: (1) does the dist transpile under `pcl` (module mode), (2) does its OWN t/ run through tools/run-dist-t.pl / the board, with perl beside it (oracle rule), (3) the blocker if not -- an existing task number, or a new one with the reproducer, (4) an estimate in sessions.  Group B starts with DBI because its blockers are already known: pclxs `io` group (#117 -- probe whether DBI's path needs it at all; trace output is the only filehandle use), a DBD's XS through tools/pcl-xs-install (the compile-at-install model), and DESTROY (docs/xs-abi5-and-destroy.md: DBI statement handles rely on it; the likely long pole).  DBI::PurePerl (DBI_PUREPERL=2) + DBD::CSV/DBD::DBM is a pure-Perl pair that makes "a DBI program runs" true BEFORE the XS half -- probe it first.

OUTPUT: a table in docs/ (list, group, transpiles?, own t/ runs?, blocker, estimate) the README roadmap quotes as "the experiment ends when these run; N of M run today" -- the count is the public progress meter.  Nothing here is scheduled; the USER decides the order after the list is fixed.

BRIEF WRITTEN s481 (Fable, 2026-09-10): ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s473/s481b/prompt.md (label s481b, IDs 1608-1620, placeholders __MAIN__/__GEN__/__MYGEN__ filled at launch).  It measures the PROPOSED list as-is (pruning by the USER costs nothing after the fact); output = docs/infrastructure-milestone.md + the README hedge count.  Fable RECOMMENDS it for the next free slot after s481a/s473t4 (the README now promises the count) -- the USER decides against s473t3 (the bug-fix queue).  Dists on the box already: Getopt-Long-2.58-0, HTTP-Tiny-0.090-0, Moo-2.005005-0, File-Temp-0.2312-0 (~/.cpan/build), Test-Simple / Text-CSV / YAML-Tiny (cpan-tests/modules); pclxs XS artifact cache EMPTY (tools/pcl-xs-install --list) so group B reports blockers.

=== DONE (s481b) ===

MEASURED 2026-09-10 on main f330e885 (the tree it lands on is v2-1280), perl
5.40.3 as the oracle.  Output: `docs/infrastructure-milestone.md` (Â§0 the rule,
Â§1 the 26 rows, Â§1a what this batch fixed, Â§2 the count, Â§3 the ranked
blockers) + the ONE README hedge sentence.  Every number is a command with its
log in the measuring worktree's `scratch/s481b/` (`<dist>.transpile.log`,
`.tsv`, `.rows.tsv`, `.perl.tsv`, `.board.log`, `batch1..4.log`, `sweep.log`,
`gate.log`).

THE COUNT: **1 of 21** on the README's list (**1 of 26** over everything
measured) â **Getopt::Long**, 8 files / 109 assertions / 0 failures, identical
to perl file for file and row for row.  THRESHOLD: every `t/` file perl does
not skip gives the same ok / not-ok counts under PCL; nothing weaker, because
the nearest misses are Try::Tiny at 93 of 104 and Data::Dumper at 406 of 829.
Total shortfall over the measurable modules 81,955 assertions, of which 77,632
are two modules (Text::CSV_PP, JSON::PP) and therefore two causes.

RANKED BLOCKERS (assertions behind each; Â§3 has the full list):
  1. the XS route is SHUT â xs-pin abi 6 vs ~/pclxs abi 8, so pcl-xs-install
     refuses every dist and ~/.pcl-cache/xs is empty â 52,599 + every group-B
     suite.  Encode alone outweighs any compiler item here.
  2. #1609 the untranslated negated POSIX class â up to 25,076 (JSON::PP)
  3. #1576 subtest â >= 1,873 (Path::Tiny, YAML::Tiny, Test::More)
  4. #1616 hash deref of a plain scalar â 635 (Log::Log4perl)
  5. #1611 runtime-name collision â >= 200 (Moo)
  6. #1574 require IO::Socket â 454 (HTTP::Tiny)
  7. #1612 re::is_regexp â 423 (Data::Dumper)
  8. the s///e + `${â¦}` interpolated-regex refusals â 337 (Template Toolkit)
  9. #1614 glob-as-hash â 86 (File::Temp)
 10. #1610 local *Pkg::NAME â the whole pure-Perl DBI route
 11. #1617 core File::Copy cannot be loaded â Mojo::File and any file copy
 12. #1575 the runner does not chdir â 24,576 planned rows, a RUNNER fix

TWO FILLERS SHIPPED under the <=1h no-new-mechanism rule, both guarded and
inverse-verified on a `git archive f330e885` extraction:
  * `while ()` = perl's infinite loop (Pl/Parser2.pm; the C-style-for arm's own
    "empty cond -> constant true").  Before: "Parser2: empty expression", a
    HARD error losing the WHOLE file; HTTP/Tiny.pm did not compile at all.
    Guard Pl/t/while-empty-01.t, 9 rows.
  * File::Spec->canonpath added to lib/File/Spec.pm (perl's
    File::Spec::Unix::_pp_canonpath minus the qnx node branch), byte-identical
    to real File::Spec on 12 paths.  Path::Tiny 1 PASS/29 FAIL 1 ok ->
    9 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 19 FAIL, 41 ok.  Guard Pl/t/file-spec-01.t, 4 rows.
  HTTP::Tiny now COMPILES and its row count does NOT move â the file-level wall
  was replaced by #1574 at load time.  Only the second number is progress.

FILED, each with a reproducer probed vs perl: #1609 #1610 #1611 #1612 #1613
#1614 #1615 #1616 #1617.  (#1615 CORRECTS #1574, whose diagnosis would have
sent a session to an export list that is already right.)

THINGS THE MEASUREMENT ALSO ESTABLISHED, worth not re-deriving:
  * The COMPILER is not the wall for the frameworks: Mojolicious 112 modules,
    Plack 70, Test-Simple 71, Log4perl 51, Moo 13, DBI.pm 8682 lines â all
    transpile with 0 died / 0 drops / 0 refusals.
  * DateTime is NOT MEASURABLE on this machine (its deps are absent, so perl
    fails 50 of 51 files too) and Template Toolkit's perl side is degraded for
    the same kind of reason (the dist is unbuilt).  Said so, not scored.
  * `pl2cl --module` exits 0 on a file it cannot fully compile (the #339
    announcement is suppressed in module mode), and the CORE modules PCL loads
    from the system perl at run time are in NO drop-census population â see
    #1617.
  * A load-order-dependent error message is not a diagnosis (#1615's method
    note): the same `require` in a loop after other failures named a different
    module than it does alone.

NOT DONE: Mojolicious's and Plack's `t/*/` suites were not run (the scoreboard
globs `t/*.t` only, and neither dist's top module loads, so the run would be a
row of zeros); DateTime's and Plack's dependency trees were not installed.
subject: PROPOSE + SIZE the CRITICAL-INFRASTRUCTURE milestone -- the thing that ends the "experiment" (USER 2026-09-09: "DBI was just an example of critical infrastructure"): a module LIST (pure-Perl / XS-through-pclxs / frameworks) for the USER to prune or extend, with a probe and a blocker per module and one estimate; the count that run today becomes the README's progress meter
